message:Header.message:Source: The Data Download Program (DDP) application is being retired. During the week of November 9, the “Build Your Package” feature in the Data Download Program (DDP) will be removed in preparation for the eventual retirement of the DDP. For complete release data, please refer to data release pages. For customized data retrieval, please use the tools available through Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED).
